A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 66-page survey, with readable text, figures, tables, equations and references supporting reliable comparison. Neither contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: Section 4.2 reports original AdAM adaptation experiments, including 10-shot FFHQ to Flowers with FID 124.46 (Figure 6) and an AFHQ-Cat sample-selection study (Figure 7).

after.justification: v3 retains the original adaptation and sample-selection experiments in Section 4.2 and Figures 6–7, including their quantitative and qualitative outcomes.

M1.justification: The model formulations and method descriptions in Sections 3–5 are identical. No algorithmic procedure, objective or component changes.

E1.justification: The datasets, tasks and tested scenarios in Figures 5–7 and Section 6.2 are unchanged, including FFHQ adaptation to Flowers and AFHQ-Cat.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 5–12 and Figures 8–10. For example, Table 6 retains TGAN, FreezeD, EWC, CDC, DCL, AdAM and RICK.

E3.justification: Figure 7 retains the 10-shot setup and FID comparison between 5,000 generated images and 5,115 AFHQ-Cat images, with results at 2,500 iterations. Other documented evaluation settings also match.

E4.justification: The domain-proximity analysis and transfer-failure examples in Figures 5–6, and the sample-selection sensitivity study in Figure 7, are unchanged. No ablation or robustness analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 7 retains the same reporting of three random sample sets. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates or statistical testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results match throughout. Figure 6 retains FID 124.46; Figure 7 retains 90.0, 71.6 and 49.9 at 2,500 iterations. Tables 5–12 have identical result entries.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, task formulations and generative-model equations in Sections 3–4 are unchanged. No assumptions, formal results, proofs or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: reviewing over 230 papers, proposing two taxonomies, analyzing the research landscape and identifying future directions.

C2.justification: The interpretations of transfer failures, sample-selection effects, evaluation limitations and comparative performance in Sections 4.2 and 6–7 are identical, as are the applicability discussions and future directions.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information, including clean-FID usage and the project website, are unchanged. The added OpenReview link supplies review metadata rather than technical or code/data access information.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries and positioning against earlier surveys in Section 2 are unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds TMLR publication information and an OpenReview review line, and updates the arXiv version/date. The scientific prose, terminology and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: v3 adds a running publication header. The new review line shifts two abstract lines from page 1 to page 2. Figures and tables retain their displays, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: The revision adds publication/review metadata and slightly changes the opening-page layout. Scientific exposition, empirical evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
